Typing "renovation" and watching the list shrink down as I go feels great — instant, no hunting. And I really like that it told me *why* that link showed up — "matched your personal note" — because otherwise I'd be confused why a link surfaced when that word isn't in its title. That little explanation is reassuring. Keeping the search bar sitting above the library, and not dumping my private note text onto the card itself, both feel right.

One thing I want to widen, though. Right now you've got it looking through titles and my notes. But when I'm trying to find something again, I often only half-remember it — and the words I remember might be in that little description line under the title, or even in the web address itself, not the title. So I'd expect a search to also look through the descriptions and the addresses, not just titles and notes. Could we broaden it so it searches across all of those? That's how I'd actually stumble my way back to a link.
